# Engines

The released community engines, each with its source, presets, simulator scenarios and golden renders,
and a README that is its one-page manual (knobs, presets, CPU cost, what to listen for, credits). Play
them on the website's synth lab; build your own with the [SDK quickstart](../sdk/docs/QUICKSTART.md).

*Generated by the lab's `tools/opfree_sync.py` from each engine's `plug.json`; don't edit by hand.*
